title: SessionAbandonment
description: One session whose accepted edits reached no commit.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

accepted_decisions.description: How many accepted edits this session had that never reached a commit.

explicit_accepted_decisions.description: How many of those accepts came from a real human gesture. Only a session with at least one explicit accept can emit a negative attributed completion.

last_decision_at.description: The session's newest decision time — the anchor the grace horizon is measured back from.

as_of.description: The newest timestamp anywhere in the facts this derivation read. The horizon is measured against this, never the wall clock, so the same facts always yield the same verdict.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.
